description: Get a station's recent observation history, newest first — the trend behind the single latest reading nws_get_observations returns (is pressure falling, is the wind picking up). NWS keeps about the last 7 days per station, and a busy airport station reports as often as every 5 minutes, so a day can run past 100 observations: narrow with start (inclusive) and end (exclusive), and page back to older observations with nextCursor. Takes a station ID; use nws_find_stations to find one near a coordinate.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's nextCursor. Omit for the first page. It carries that query's start, end, and applied limit, so those inputs apply to the first page only. Each page continues from just before the oldest observation of the one before it, so pages neither repeat nor skip an observation.

end.description: Time to stop before (exclusive), in the same format as start. Omit to start from the most recent observation.

limit.description: Observations per page, newest first. A page holds at most 100; a larger limit (up to 10000) is served as 100 and reported through requestedLimit and effectiveLimit. When older observations remain in the window, the response carries nextCursor; pass it back as cursor for them.

start.description: Earliest observation time to include (inclusive), as an ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an offset (e.g., "2026-09-30T00:00:00Z" or "2026-09-29T17:00:00-07:00"). Omit to reach back as far as NWS keeps, about 7 days.

station_id.description: Observation station ID (e.g., "KSEA"), case-insensitive. Use nws_find_stations to discover station IDs near a coordinate.

name: nws_get_observation_history

cap.description: The page limit this page holds, when truncated is true

effectiveLimit.description: The page size applied instead of requestedLimit; continued pages keep it. Absent when the limit was within the cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `station_not_found`: Station ID is malformed or does not exist in the NWS network. `invalid_time_window`: start or end is not a valid ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an offset, or start is not before end. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next, older page — pass it back as cursor. Present only when older observations remain in the window; omitted on the last page.

notice.description: Guidance when the requested limit exceeded the page cap, when the window held no observations (NWS keeps about the last 7 days), or when older observations remain beyond this page.

observations.description: Observations in the window, newest first

items.description: One observation; a measurement the station did not report is null, never 0
Single cloud layer with cover amount and base height

dewpointC.description: Dewpoint in Celsius, to one decimal

heatIndexC.description: Heat index in Celsius, to one decimal

precipitationLast3HoursMm.description: Precipitation in the past 3 hours in mm, to 0.1 mm, carried by the hourly reports nearest 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC. 0 is a trace (under 0.01 in); null means no amount was reported.

precipitationLast6HoursMm.description: Precipitation in the past 6 hours in mm, to 0.1 mm, carried by the hourly reports nearest 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC. 0 is a trace (under 0.01 in); null means no amount was reported.

precipitationLastHourMm.description: Precipitation in the past hour in mm, to 0.1 mm. 0 is a trace (under 0.01 in), not a dry hour; null means no amount was reported, the usual value for a dry hour and on 5-minute reports.

temperatureC.description: Temperature in Celsius, to one decimal (e.g., 8.3)

textDescription.description: Conditions summary (e.g., "Mostly Cloudy"); empty when not reported

windChillC.description: Wind chill in Celsius, to one decimal

requestedLimit.description: The limit asked for, when it exceeded the 100-observation page cap; absent otherwise.

shown.description: Number of observations returned in this page

truncated.description: True when older observations remain in the window past this page; continue with nextCursor.

title: Nws Get Observation History
